ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Shipped"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "In Transit"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Delivered")), OR(ISBLANK(Carrier__c), ISBLANK(Tracking_Number__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Carrier and tracking number are required after a shipment leaves the warehouse.
